categories.main_business_segments: Sansec Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on cryptographic technology innovation and the development, production, sales, and services of commercial cryptographic products. Its main product lines include cryptographic chips, cryptographic modules, cryptographic machines, and cryptographic systems, providing comprehensive cryptographic solutions for network information security. The company serves industries such as finance, government, cloud service providers, telecommunications, energy, transportation, and emerging fields like AI, IoT, blockchain, and digital currency.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with core technologies including high-performance cryptographic computation, low-power secure hardware platforms, cross-domain cryptographic service platforms, and post-quantum cryptography algorithms. It has developed self-designed cryptographic chips (e.g., XS100, XT100, XT200, XR100), secure cryptographic modules, and integrated cryptographic machines. Production combines in-house manufacturing of core processes (programming, testing, assembly) with outsourced PCB soldering. The company also offers cryptographic technical services tailored to customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sansec's primary customers include network security product and solution providers who integrate its cryptographic products, as well as end-users in sectors such as finance, government, cloud service providers, telecommunications, energy, transportation, healthcare, education, and emerging digital economy sectors. The company serves both upstream solution integrators and downstream industry end-users, with a significant portion of sales to cooperative vendors and growing direct sales to end customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and multiple subsidiaries across key regions including Shandong, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and others. It has expanded overseas by establishing subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore to develop the Asia-Pacific cryptographic security market and build a global cloud cryptographic service system. Its sales and service network covers major Chinese regions such as East China, North China, South China, and Central China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sansec operates mainly in the upstream segment of the network information security supply chain as a provider of core cryptographic infrastructure products and solutions. It supplies cryptographic chips, modules, machines, and systems to network security product manufacturers, who then integrate these into broader security solutions for various industries. The company also provides cryptographic technical services, positioning itself as a foundational technology supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in cryptographic technologies, focusing on post-quantum cryptography, cloud-native cryptographic services, IoT security chips, high-performance cryptographic algorithms, and integrated cryptographic platforms. It invests heavily in R&D (over 27% of revenue), maintains a large R&D team, and actively participates in national and industry cryptographic standards development. Strategic acquisitions (e.g., Jiangnan Tianan) enhance its product ecosystem and market reach. The company also emphasizes expanding cryptographic applications in emerging fields like AI, blockchain, digital currency, and trusted data spaces.
categories.revenue_model: Sansec generates revenue primarily through direct sales of cryptographic products including chips, modules, machines, and systems. It also earns income from providing cryptographic technical services such as consulting, maintenance, and support. The company employs a direct sales model targeting both cooperative vendors and end customers, with revenues recognized upon product delivery and service acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sansec is a leading domestic commercial cryptographic infrastructure provider in China, distinguished by its full-stack proprietary cryptographic product portfolio from chips to systems. It is among the top cryptographic companies with the most high-security level (level 3) certified products. Through strategic acquisitions of Jiangnan Keyou and Jiangnan Tianan, it has consolidated its position as a market leader, especially in cloud cryptographic security, serving major cloud providers and key industries like finance, telecom, and energy. The company holds a competitive edge in technology innovation and comprehensive product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sansec achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 473.2 million, representing a 31.96% year-over-year increase, driven by expanded sales to core strategic customers and growth in cloud service providers, telecom operators, energy, and transportation sectors. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 42.1 million, a 37.4% decrease due to increased R&D and sales expenses and changes in cash management. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.18 billion and net assets of RMB 1.85 billion, with a stable financial scale and ongoing investment in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sansec emphasizes its proprietary core cryptographic technologies, including self-developed chips and post-quantum cryptography products, offering high-performance, secure, and compliant cryptographic solutions. Its comprehensive product ecosystem supports a wide range of cryptographic algorithms and applications, ensuring supply chain security and technological independence. The company differentiates itself through advanced R&D capabilities, extensive product certifications, strategic industry partnerships, and early mover advantages in emerging fields such as cloud cryptography, AI security, and quantum-resistant cryptography.
